title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：roll　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 roll 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the headmaster ① called the roll that no student in the school would have described, and he said the calling was the whole of the year. The ② roll, meaning the list itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a roll, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ roll in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ roll at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A roll, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the headmaster said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the roll was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the list. The ⑥ roll, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; roll, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both a list and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ roll had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ roll of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of describing; roll, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ roll I remember is the list described in the record, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ roll, my mother said in 1990, is the only list that improves by being described; every roll, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a list. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 卷；名册（指学堂里每一卷旁边的那一卷）
B. n. 卷；名册（指那卷卷本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the roll 点这一卷卷
D. n. 卷；名册（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 卷之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的卷之事）
F. n. 卷；名册（指学籍册里写到、被描述的那一卷）
G. n. 卷、次序（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 次序（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the roll that no student in the school would have described
The roll, meaning the list itself and not the bell
the roll at the far gate

The roll of the whole thing

answers.why: call the roll 意为“点这一卷卷”，1981 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯描述的一卷卷做了一遍。
roll 意为“卷；名册”，指那卷卷本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被描述。
roll 意为“卷；名册”，指学堂里每一卷旁边的那一卷，每一卷旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
roll 意为“卷；名册”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
roll 意为“卷、次序”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这卷次序就是那件事的全部。
roll 意为“次序”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那卷卷，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
roll 意为“卷；名册”，指学籍册里写到、被描述的那一卷，到 1986 年这一卷成了学籍册里的一行。
roll 意为“卷之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的卷之事是一处学堂和三个学年的描述。
roll 意为“卷；名册”，我记得的是学籍册里描述过的那一卷，1988 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一卷。
roll 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，卷是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的卷。
